_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ssti#1, correcting a correction. The entry first quoted 'no SCATRA discretisation found' from a '4C_tsi_factory.cpp' (neither exists), then was corrected to 'Unsupported solid element type!' from tsi/4C_tsi_utils.cpp. That literal is in the binary but is NOT what an SSTI deck with SOLID elements produces: swapping SOLIDSCATRA for SOLID on upstream ssti_mono_3D_3hex8_elch_s2i_butlervolmerthermo_growthlaw.4C.yaml fails first at the element line, "After parsing, the line still contains 'TYPE ElchElectrode'." from core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec.cpp, because SOLID has no TYPE key; once the TYPE token is also removed so the line parses, the real diagnostic appears, from src/ssti/4C_ssti_utils.cpp inside SSTIScatraStructureCloneStrategy, ending 'Use SOLIDSCATRA, WALLSCATRA or SHELLSCATRA elements with meaningful ImplType instead!'. Neither quoted string occurs in either arm and 4C_tsi_utils.cpp is never named. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: After parsing, the line still contains 'TYPE ElchElectrode'.
Use SOLIDSCATRA, WALLSCATRA or SHELLSCATRA elements with meaningful ImplType instead!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the CLEAN arm: keep the element category SOLIDSCATRA (the TYPE tokens are still stripped, so the only change left is one 4C accepts). The clone strategy is satisfied, EXIT_CLEAN becomes 0 and the SSTI diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the NAIVE arm: keep SOLIDSCATRA. The element line parses, EXIT_NAIVE becomes 0 and the leftover-token diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
